item.title: Ishan Kishan makes giant strides in ICC Men’s T20I Rankings for batters; Abhishek Sharma maintains top spot
item.description: Indian wicketkeeper-batter Ishan Kishan has leapfrogged 32 slots in the updated ICC Men's T20I batter rankings after an impressive comeback series against New Zealand, where the southpaw amassed 215 runs in four innings at a strike-rate of 231.18 with one hundred and a fifty. item.title: “Fitness is getting better…”: Rishabh Pant optimistic about returning to competitive cricket soon
item.description: India wicketkeeper-batter Rishabh Pant on Tuesday (February 4) sounded hopeful about his early return to competitive cricket, saying his recovery from injury is progressing well and that he is not far from getting back on the field. Pant has been away from action since January 10 after sustaining a right-sided internal oblique muscle tear during a practice session in Vadodara, when he was hit above the waist by a ball from a throwdown specialist. item.title: Indian cricket fraternity reacts as India U19 storms into U19 World Cup final; dominates Afghanistan in 7-wicket win
item.description: India and Afghanistan clashed in the second semi-final of the ongoing ICC U19 World Cup on February 4, 2026. England U19 already defeated Australia U19 in the first semi-final to book their tickets in the final. Afghanistan U19 captain Mahboob Khan won the toss and chose to bat first. Openers Osman Sadat (39) and Khalid Ahmadzai (31) added 52 runs for the first wicket in a sedated start. But their middle order clicked as Faisal Shinozada and Uzairullah Niazai added 148 runs for the third wicket.
